[00:10] fears, and these stocks are going to benefit the most. Think of cyclical stocks like mortgage
[00:14] companies, UWMC, financials like Bank of America, which are down this year, raw material companies
[00:20] like ALB, which had a stunning 10% day today, solar companies that have been hit by high interest
[00:25] rates like Enphase, and many small cap stocks that are trading at super low valuations like
[00:29] Perion Network. I've been saying all along that I'm very bullish and I do believe that all those
[00:34] groups of stocks that I mentioned are going to thrive in 2024 and 2025. Be sure to check out
[00:39] the stock that's Discord for education, trade alerts, and investment alerts in real time.
[00:43] Link on my profile.
